# CANDIDATE: BOLL_SQUEEZE_VIX_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A Bollinger Band squeeze (low volatility contraction) combined with rising VIX signals an imminent volatility expansion that often breaks upward. The edge exists because volatility contraction precedes expansion, and rising VIX confirms increasing fear/expectation of movement, while a volume-confirmed close above the upper band validates genuine breakout momentum rather than a fakeout.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Trigger when all conditions are met on the same 5-minute bar:
- Bollinger Band width (upper - lower) < 20-period average of Band width (squeeze)
- Today's VIX > yesterday's VIX (rising volatility expectation)
- Close price > upper Bollinger Band (breakout)
- Volume on that bar > 1.5 × 20-bar average volume (participation confirmation)

**Exit:** 
- Stop-loss: lower Bollinger Band (dynamic volatility-based stop)
- Profit target: 2 × ATR above entry price OR trailing stop of 10% off the high-water mark (whichever hits first)
- Additional regime filter: Only active when VIX < 30 (to avoid false breakouts in high volatility) and avoid first 15 minutes after open (9:30-9:45 ET)

5. **Failure modes:**

   - Max drawdown: Consecutive false breakouts in choppy markets could produce significant drawdown
   - Blow-up scenario: Volatility expansion breaking downward (against long position) triggering stop-loss during sharp selloff
6. **Concentration:** Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine if top-5 days drive disproportionate P&L
